integrity: The copula and latent common-shock construction are attributed to their originating literature; only the exact total-correlation reduction, three-term large-d expansion and remainder bounds are asserted here. Symbolic proof is in RESULT.md and the finite numerical cross-check is in check.py.
scientific_limitations: Fixed interior 0<theta<1 as dimension grows; no uniform endpoint asymptotics, heterogeneous-parameter extension or independent priority certification. A non-exhaustive literature search cannot establish global uniqueness.
title: Sharp high-dimensional total-correlation law for the multivariate Raftery copula
